messages:
alex: Heads-up — Hearthly private deploy is scheduled for tomorrow morning (09:00 PST). Quick status check: networking and air-gap certs are ✅/❌?
maria: Network team reports firewall rules mostly in, but customer still missing egress NAT mapping from their FW team. Waiting on their ticket (HRT-884).
alex: Do we have fallback if NAT mapping doesn't arrive?
devon: We can use our egress-proxy as fallback but it requires a short maintenance window and account owner sign-off. Needs infra change in rollout manifest.
mar ia: (typo) — maria: re: fallback — customer legal asked for no shared proxies if possible. They preferred we run egress on their NAT.
sam: Is there an interim per-tenant policy we can enable to reduce blast radius? Maybe strict allowlist to only Redwood control plane endpoints + model registry?
devon: Yes — can flip tenant-egress-mode to "restricted" and pin DST IPs. Command: `rdctl tenant update hearthly --egress-mode restricted --allowed-ips 52.23.11.7,52.23.11.8`
alex: Who can run that? I don't have perms for rdctl in prod.
irene: I can run it, but I need the exact IP list from infra.
infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved 2026-03-19T09:00-09:30 PST for hearthly onprem rollout (owner: maria).
maria: @devon @irene I pasted the IPs from infra infra-ticket: 52.23.11.7, 52.23.11.8, 18.204.55.12. @irene please run rdctl when ready and ping ops.
irene: Running now, will update when completed.
alex: Also, the air-gap image sync still failing: their registry is returning 403 on our signed URL. Anyone seen that before?
sam: 403 on signed URL usually means clock skew or wrong key scope. Did customer include the presigned token exactly as we generated?
devon: They used the mirror helper and we logged `403: token expired`. The helper was given yesterday; looks like their registry has stricter TTL. I'll regenerate with 48h TTL and instruct them to start sync within 2 hours.
maria: Please add note: if they restart sync after 4am their infra team is usually available. We should avoid midnight windows.
irene: rdctl change completed — tenant in restricted egress mode and IPs pinned. Verified connectivity to control plane endpoints from their bastion.
alex: Great. Devon, can you post the new signed URL + instructions as a secure note on HRT-884? Mark "start sync during 04:00-06:00 UTC".
devon: Will do. Also attaching small checklist for tomorrow's cutover: 1) certs validated on customer reg, 2) egress pinned, 3) KV-cache warmup run, 4) canary routing 10% for 15m, 5) rollback playbook ready.
sam: Can we get a CR for the egress-mode toggle? Just to have audit trail.
irene: Filed CR-1124 referencing this thread.
alex: Thanks team. If we hit a late NAT mapping from customer, fallback is infra-proxy but legal may push back. Keep all comms in HRT-884 and i'll be on-call during the window. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll stay on the thread and coordinate with customer L3. See you all tomorrow morning. :coffee:
